title: How Astronauts Fixed Hubble's Flawed Mirror in Orbit
description: Hubble launched in 1990 with a tiny mirror error that blurred its vision. Astronauts flew five spacewalks to repair the observatory, enabling over 1.6 million space observations.
hook_card: The telescope that was born blind

shots.narration: Hubble launched on 24 April 1990 aboard the space shuttle Discovery with a 2.4-metre mirror.
Ground wrong by about 2 microns, a fiftieth of a hair's width, its first images were blurred.
In December 1993, shuttle astronauts installed corrective optics during five spacewalks, making Hubble's vision sharp.
Hubble orbits about 540 kilometres above Earth, circling the planet once every 95 minutes.
Across five servicing missions, astronauts replaced the telescope's cameras, gyroscopes, and solar panels.
The fifth and final servicing mission to upgrade the orbiting observatory took place in 2009.
After its final repairs were complete, the upgraded telescope was released back into orbit.
Over its operational lifetime, Hubble has made more than 1.6 million observations of the universe.
